context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 16 verified the demo mode feature. Demo mode is activated by clicking 'See A Demo' button on landing page. It sets sessionStorage 'demo_mode' flag to 'true'. All pages check this flag and use hardcoded demo data instead of API calls. Exit Demo clears the flag and redirects to landing page. Fixed minor bug in Integrations.jsx where DEMO_LOCATIONS used wrong field names.
